coursework.summary: NTU’s 2025 statement generally permits assignment AI use, with teacher prohibitions for pedagogical reasons. Current Library guidance requires module instructions and explicit permission for extensive use. Scope: Dated institutional statement and current Library guidance; internal full teaching policy not obtained.

exams.summary: Do not access AI during exams where external resources are forbidden. Check the exact examination instructions; open-resource exams do not automatically authorise AI. Scope: NTU Library guidance; restriction applies when external resources are not permitted.

ai_disclosure.summary: Disclose AI assistance in submissions and follow module requirements. Detailed prompt/output records and the format depend on the instructor; thesis submissions have a separate Statement of Originality requirement. Scope: Student Library guidance; separate thesis submission declarations.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Do not upload protected research data to external GenAI unless legal, restricted-access and no-retention conditions are met, plus owner permission where applicable or RCA agreement. The RCA route does not waive the other safeguards. Scope: Research data; not approval of all institutional tools for sensitive coursework.

academic_integrity.summary: Misrepresenting AI work is academic misconduct in the Library’s handbook summary. Research plagiarism and research-misconduct referral have their own conditions; referral is not guilt or an automatic sanction. Scope: Public Library summary and separately scoped research misconduct procedure.

teaching_guidance.summary: Consult instructor and assignment guidance before using AI. Extensive AI involvement requires explicit instructor permission under the Library guidance. Scope: Current public Library guidance; full internal teaching policy not obtained.

research_guidance.summary: Acknowledge research use beyond basic spelling/grammar checks, retain human authorship and follow stricter recipient rules. Label and document AI visuals; experimental images have explicit methodology exceptions, not permission to fabricate results. Scope: Research proposals, scholarly outputs and theses; original should/must wording remains in evidence.

security_procurement.summary: Research data conditions are explicit. The obtained public sources do not establish a complete university-wide procurement process or approval of every service for protected data. Scope: Research data conditions; wider procurement evidence remains incomplete.

approved_tools.summary: NTU announced Google AI tools for undergraduates from August 2026; NALA tutors are deployed by educators. Personal account access and costs were not tested. Access does not grant assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: NTU announced Google AI tools for undergraduates from August 2026; NALA tutors are deployed by educators. Personal account access and costs were not tested. Access does not grant assessment permission.

policy_presence.summary: Official policy/guidance sources exist; this does not establish complete policy coverage or a uniform assessment permission.
